about.body:
I help founders and coaches say what they do in a way customers understand and act on.

My work starts with the message: what you offer, who it is for, and why it matters now. Then I build the story around it, so every page, email, and post pulls in the same direction.

This site is my record of the work. If I say I have done it, you can see it here.
